title: XRP and Solana ETFs thrive as over $4B in Bitcoin and Ethereum exits the market
summary: A sharp divergence emerged in the crypto ETF market this month. According to SoSo Value data, the new products tracking Solana and XRP are attracting significant capital, contrasting with a severe wave of outflows from established Bitcoin and Ethereum funds.
